verdict.rationale: Customer.io publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec covering the Track, App, and Design Studio APIs, and a probe confirmed it is live. It also provides a Postman collection for running API calls, and the CLI makes endpoints self-describing via `cio schema`. However, runnable examples depend on external tools (Postman, the CLI) rather than an interactive reference built into the docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-docs interactive API explorer with a try-it/runnable-request feature, inline runnable code examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.
